name: Emtricitabine
description: A cytidine analogue reverse transcriptase inhibitor approved for HIV-1, almost always given in fixed-dose combination. Carries a boxed warning for post-treatment hepatitis B exacerbation.

systems.note: Reverse transcriptase inhibition; the labelled antiviral indication.
Renally cleared; dose adjustment is labelled.
Boxed warning for post-treatment hepatitis B exacerbation and for lactic acidosis with hepatomegaly.

monitors.why: Boxed hepatitis B exacerbation and hepatic steatosis warnings.
